subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Snapchat's Disappearing Promise
description: A short lesson to help you apply Snapchat's Disappearing Promise.

hook.text: Snapchat promised photos would disappear in seconds. The FTC said that was a lie.

buildup.text: Snapchat marketed itself as the safe app — messages that vanish meant privacy was guaranteed.

discovery.text: The FTC found that Snapchat stored photos, collected location data, and had a vulnerability exposing user data.

twist.text: Third-party apps easily saved 'disappearing' snaps. Nothing digital truly disappears.

climax.text: Snapchat sold the illusion of privacy. The reality was standard data collection behind a disappearing act.

quiz.question: What did the FTC find about Snapchat's privacy claims?
options: Snapchat stored photos and collected data despite promising messages disappeared
Snapchat perfectly protected all user data
Snapchat only collected data from paid users
